item.title: [LU-19179] Remove 3.10 kernel support (rhel/rocky/centos7)
item.description: This is way too old and now that nothing in our testing pipeline depends on it, we should drop it to save resources.

status.description: This issue is being actively worked on at the moment by the assignee.
